MATTHEVV.|65 HOLY weeke.}}</noinclude>but vvith a finger of their ovvne they vvil not moue them. {{verse|chapter=23|verse=5}}† But they doe al their vvorkes, for to be seen of men. for they make brode their {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ These phylacteries were peeces of parchement, wherein they wrote the ten cōmaundements, and folded it, and caried it on their forehead before their eies, imagining grosly and superstitiously, that so they fulfilled that which is said Deu. 6, ''They shal be immoueable before thine eies''. Hiero. in 23 Mat.}}∷ phylacteries, and enlarge their {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Deu. 22, 12. Nu. 15, 38.''}}* fringes. {{verse|chapter=23|verse=6}}† And they ‖ loue the first places at suppers, and {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 12, 38.''}}* the first chaires in the Synagogs, {{verse|chapter=23|verse=7}}† and salutations in the market-place, and to be called of men, Rabbi. {{verse|chapter=23|verse=8}}† But be not you called Rabbi. for ‖ one is your maister, and al you are brethren. {{verse|chapter=23|verse=9}}† And call none father to your self vpon earth: for one is your father, he that is in heauen. {{verse|chapter=23|verse=10}}† Neither {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ia. 3, 1.''}}* be ye called ‖ maisters: for one is your maister, Christ. {{verse|chapter=23|verse=11}}† He that is the greater of you, shal be your seruiteur. {{verse|chapter=23|verse=12}}† And he that exalteth him self, shal be humbled: and he that humbleth him self, shal be exalted.⊣

{{verse|chapter=23|verse=13}}† But vvo to you ‖ Scribes & Pharisees, hypocrites: because you shut the kingdom of heauen before men. For your selues do not enter in: & those that are going in, you suffer not to enter.

{{verse|chapter=23|verse=14}}† Wo to you Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites: because you {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Lu. 20, 47.''}}* deuoure vvidovves houses, ‖ praying long prayers. for this you shal receiue the greater iudgement.

{{verse|chapter=23|verse=15}}† Wo to you Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites: because you goe round about the sea and the land, to make one proselyte: and vvhen he is made, you make him the childe of hel ‖ double more then your selues.

{{verse|chapter=23|verse=16}}† Wo to you blinde guides, that say, Whosoeuer shal svveare by the temple, it is nothing: but he that shal svveare by the gold of the temple, is bound. {{verse|chapter=23|verse=17}}† Ye foolish and blinde, for vvhether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold? {{verse|chapter=23|verse=18}}† And vvhosoeuer shal svveare by the altar, it is nothing: but vvhosoeuer shal sweare by the gift that is vpon it, is bound. {{verse|chapter=23|verse=19}}† Ye blinde, for vvhether is greater, the gift, or the altar that ‖ sanctifieth the gift? {{verse|chapter=23|verse=20}}† He therfore that sweareth by the altar, sweareth by it and by al things that are vpon it: {{verse|chapter=23|verse=21}}† and vvhosoeuer shal svveare by the temple, sweareth by it and ‖ by him that dvvelleth in it: {{verse|chapter=23|verse=22}}† and he that sweareth by heauen, svveareth by the throne of God & by him that sitteth thereon.

{{verse|chapter=23|verse=23}}† Wo to you Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites: because you tithe mint, and anise, and cummin, and haue left the vveightier things of the lavv, iudgement, and mercie, and faith. these things you ought to haue done, & not to haue omitted those. {{verse|chapter=23|verse=24}}† Blinde guides, that straine a gnat, and swallow a camel.<noinclude>{{rh||I|Wo}}</noinclude>
